name: workledger
description: Self-hosted working-time, absence, approval, and monthly-record application.

scripts.lint: pnpm run workspace:check && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run workspace:check && node --test scripts/check-workspace.test.mjs scripts/check-boundaries.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test:e2e
scripts.build: pnpm run workspace:check && tsc --build --pretty false --force && node scripts/check-workspace-build.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build
